fusions.name: Torpor Cloud
fusions.desc: Breathes a cone of numbing venom ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and stunning it for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A thrown stinger that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shared Sun
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and your allies for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Left Behind
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds, and decoy stingers fight beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
